name: Elite: circles
summary: The circles: the sun filled, the planet outlined, the chart's range circle, the hit flashes.

entries.name: OutlineRunUpRight
entries.summary: Plot an outline run: up the screen, x growing (the alternate registers step it)

entries.name: OutlineRunUpLeft
entries.summary: Plot an outline run: up the screen, x shrinking

entries.name: OutlineRunDownRight
entries.summary: The same, down the screen, x growing (known from the code only)

entries.name: OutlineRunDownLeft
entries.summary: The same, down the screen, x shrinking (known from the code only)

entries.name: ArcRunRight
entries.summary: Plot one arc run of the outline, x growing (31504 instructions in the recordings)

entries.name: ArcRunLeft
entries.summary: Plot one arc run, x shrinking

entries.name: OutlineEdgeUp
entries.summary: Plot an edge run going up, filled or outlined by CircleMode

entries.name: OutlineEdgeDown
entries.summary: Plot an edge run going down

entries.name: DrawCircleDI
entries.summary: Draw a filled circle with interrupts off (the sun; known from the code only: no recording saw the sun)

entries.name: DrawCircle
entries.summary: Draw an outlined circle (the planet), radius 9 or more

entries.name: DrawCircleShape
entries.summary: Draw the circle CircleX, CircleY, CircleQuadrant, CircleRadius: sort it by the view's edges

entries.name: Square
entries.summary: HL = A * A from the table of squares ($BE00 low bytes, $BF00 high bytes)

entries.name: CircleArcs
entries.summary: A circle wholly inside the view: the four quarter arcs

entries.name: CircleArc
entries.summary: One quarter arc from the circle's top or bottom row, by the screen address of its first point

entries.name: FillClipped
entries.summary: A circle cut by the view's top or bottom: the rows inside, each from its half width

entries.name: FillCorner
entries.summary: A circle cut by two edges

entries.name: SpanEndLeft
entries.summary: One end of a row run, the left side (known from the code only)

entries.name: SpanEndRight
entries.summary: The other end (known from the code only)

entries.name: ArcSeed
entries.summary: The alternate registers for an arc: the Bresenham terms from the centre (known from the code only)

entries.name: PointLeft
entries.summary: HL = the back buffer address of point (C, A), C = the mask of its leftmost pixel

entries.name: PointRight
entries.summary: HL = the address of point (C, A), the mask of its rightmost pixel (B kept in CirclePointX)

entries.name: SpanStep
entries.summary: The run's Bresenham step from the half width at the row

entries.name: SpanStart
entries.summary: The run's start address and mask (outline mode goes to OutlineSpanStart $8FF9)

entries.name: HalfChord
entries.summary: A = sqrt(radius^2 - row^2): the half width of the circle at a row, by bisection over the squares

entries.name: FillPushes1
entries.summary: A chain of 16 PUSH AF: FillSpan1's patched JR enters it to write the run's whole bytes

entries.name: FillPushes2
entries.summary: The second chain of 16 PUSH AF

entries.name: FillSpanTest2
entries.summary: Test a filled run against the view, then fill it (the second engine)

entries.name: FillPushes3
entries.summary: The third chain

entries.name: FillPushes4
entries.summary: The fourth chain

entries.name: FillSpanTest3
entries.summary: Test a filled run against the view, then fill it (the third engine)

entries.name: FillPushes5
entries.summary: The fifth chain

entries.name: FillPushes6
entries.summary: The sixth chain

entries.name: CircleLineUp
entries.summary: HL one pixel line up the back buffer (a character row boundary through CircleRowUp)

entries.name: CircleRowUp
entries.summary: DE one character row up

entries.name: CircleLineDown
entries.summary: HL one pixel line down

entries.name: CircleRowDown
entries.summary: DE one character row down

entries.name: CircleAbort
entries.summary: Leave the circle code from inside a run: SP back from CircleSP

entries.name: DrawChartCircle
entries.summary: Draw the chart's range circle: the circle code patched for the screen, then back

entries.name: HitFlash
entries.summary: Draw the growing red circles of the ships just hit, on the screen (HitFlashes $9C96)

entries.name: CircleBase
entries.summary: Patch the circle code's screen base: HL and A the new page bytes

entries.name: OutlineEdgeStart
entries.summary: The outline mode's edge set-up at a cell start (known from the code only)

entries.name: MaskRight
entries.summary: B = the single pixel mask of column A (rotating right)

entries.name: MaskLeft
entries.summary: C = the single pixel mask of column CirclePointX (rotating left)

entries.name: OutlineSpanStart
entries.summary: The outline mode's run set-up

entries.name: OutlineRunUp
entries.summary: Plot an outline run going up (the stepping in the alternate registers)

entries.name: OutlineRunDown
entries.summary: Plot an outline run going down

entries.name: OutlinePlotTop
entries.summary: Plot the outline from the top of the circle (the first engine)

entries.name: OutlinePlotSide
entries.summary: Plot the outline along a side (5730 runs)

entries.name: OutlinePixel
entries.summary: OR the pixel C into (HL), step the row; the outline's inner loop (1787849 instructions)

entries.name: OutlineStepX
entries.summary: Rotate the mask: one pixel along x

entries.name: OutlineStepY
entries.summary: The Bresenham term for a step in y

entries.name: OutlineStep
entries.summary: The Bresenham decision: a step in x, y or both

entries.name: OutlinePixels
entries.summary: Plot the two mirrored pixels of a row and step (442222 instructions)

labels.name: CircleZero
labels.comment: One byte no code reads (known from the code only)

labels.name: CircleY
labels.comment: The centre's offset from the view's centre, down or up by CircleQuadrant bit 1

labels.name: CircleX
labels.comment: The centre's offset across, by bit 0

labels.name: CircleQuadrant
labels.comment: Bit 0 x positive (right), bit 1 y positive (up), bits 2 and 3 the centre off the view across or down

labels.name: CircleRadius
labels.comment: The radius in pixels (9 and more drawn)

labels.name: CircleRowOffset
labels.comment: DrawCircleShape's working copy of CircleY, clipped to the edge it meets

labels.name: CircleColOffset
labels.comment: Its copy of CircleX

labels.name: CircleScreenY
labels.comment: The centre's row: 64 - or + CircleY

labels.name: CircleScreenX
labels.comment: The centre's column: 128 + or - CircleX

labels.name: ClipHalfWidth
labels.comment: The half width of the circle at the clipping row (HalfChord)

labels.name: CircleSP
labels.comment: The stack pointer saved while the fills PUSH and the chart patches POP

labels.name: HalfChordTarget
labels.comment: HalfChord's radius² - row²

labels.name: CirclePointX
labels.comment: PointRight's x

labels.name: RunRight
labels.comment: 1 while the run being plotted grows x (the right half), 0 while it shrinks x; the fills read it to pick the edge test

labels.name: CircleMode
labels.comment: 0 a filled circle (the sun), 1 an outline (the planet)

labels.name: ChartPatchCount
labels.comment: The 32 bytes DrawChartCircle patches and puts back

labels.name: ChartPatch
labels.comment: The 32 code bytes for the chart screens

labels.name: ViewPatch
labels.comment: The 32 code bytes for the 3D view

labels.name: CirclePatchSites
labels.comment: The 32 code addresses DrawChartCircle patches

labels.name: CircleSpare
labels.comment: Two zeros

labels.name: FillWord
labels.comment: $FFFF: AF for the PUSH chains

labels.name: CircleUnused
labels.comment: One unused byte
